title: Incident
description: A real-world event in which an AI system caused, or was alleged to have caused, harm, failure, or a governance breach. Incidents are the primary evidence base for why governance decisions get made.

occurred_date.description: Date the incident occurred (or was first publicly disclosed, if the occurrence date is unknown). Distinct from created_date, which is record-creation time.

organizations_involved.description: Organisations named as operating, deploying, or affected by the AI system involved.

harm_types.description: Categories of harm caused or alleged.

ai_system_category.description: The kind of AI system involved (e.g. 'facial_recognition', 'generative_ai', 'credit_scoring', 'hiring_screening').

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdictions where the incident occurred or had legal effect.

severity.description: Contributor-assessed severity of the incident's impact.

root_cause.description: Known or alleged underlying cause of the incident.
